newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds firmer in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds firmer in quiet trading.

text.p: 1050 GMT - Swiss bonds were firmer in quiet trading with the market profiting from overnight gains in US bonds, dealers said. * June Conf future up four basis points at 121.40 percent. * 10-year benchmark government bond up 15 bps, yields 3.28. * 10-year Swiss franc swaps down two bps to 3.62/72 percent.
